about: Federal contracts panel (#563 COWORK #1 D5): USAspending recipient names mapped to a listed company in our universe WHERE THE EXACT-NAME RULE CANNOT, each with its basis. Built from the relay evidence run 35982772478 (top 1,000 recipients, 12 months to 2026-08-31); USAspending parent records were checked by hand because some are stale (Sikorsky, Amentum, V2X). Exclusions are names that must never map. Joint ventures, universities and private firms stay unmapped by design, and so do national-laboratory M&O operators EVEN WHEN a listed company owns the operator (#563 COWORK #4): a lab's operating budget is not the owner's contract line.
